It previously pointed at the bare site root with a q parameter, i.e. the HomePage route, which reads no query string at all, so the sitelinks searchbox advertised a search that did not exist. The literal old URL is deliberately not repeated here, so that grepping this repo for that fake target returns nothing. The agent search at /agent/search is JSON for machines and is deliberately NOT advertised here. --> x4 PayAPI Market Home › Promote an x402 endpoint Where do I promote an x402 endpoint so agents find it? Short answer: agents don't scroll social feeds. They find paid endpoints by querying catalogues, over MCP or plain HTTP, and then read your 402 before they pay. So promotion for an x402 endpoint mostly means getting listed in the catalogues agents query, with a price and a receipt they can check. On PayAPI Market that listing is free, there's no per-request fee, and agents pay your wallet directly.
